task.description:
Re-gate (rework 1) — validate the updated TC-DDL-04-AC6 + TC-DDL-04-AC6b in tests/specs/DDL-04.md and ddl04_backfill_loop_test.zig.

Checks (same 5 as before, plus new):
1. TC-DDL-04-AC6 documented with correct assertions (status='applied', backfill_batch_size).
2. TC-DDL-04-AC6b documented: uses halving config, asserts backfill_batch_size = halved value (not 5000).
3. TC-DDL-04-AC6b implementation asserts a value distinguishable from the pre-fix literal (i.e. NOT 5000).
4. Both tests runnable (no SkipZigTest), isolated, self-sufficient.
5. ISS-0716 AC1 (adaptive batch_size persisted) now provably covered.

Return PASS or FAIL.

result.summary: TC-DDL-04-AC6 and TC-DDL-04-AC6b validated — all 5 checks pass. (1) AC6 spec documents status='applied' and backfill_batch_size=5000; implementation asserts both via expectEqualStrings. (2) AC6b spec documents halving config (batch_timeout_ms=1) and asserts backfill_batch_size=1250, explicitly not 5000. (3) AC6b implementation asserts expectEqualStrings("1250", row[0]) — unambiguously distinguishable from the pre-fix literal 5000. (4) Both tests have no SkipZigTest, use per-test UUIDs from setupFixtures, have defer cleanup, and hard-fail on missing BPM_TEST_DB_URL. (5) ISS-0716 AC1 (adaptive batch_size persisted) is provably covered: AC6b seeds 6000 rows, forces halving via 1 ms timeout, and asserts plat_migration_state.backfill_batch_size=1250.
